versions.changelog:
Initial release of core financial analysis tools:

- Provides commands for building DCF, LBO, three-statement models, comparable company analysis, and competitive landscape analysis.
- Enables auditing and debugging of financial models for errors and integrity.
- Supports creating reusable PowerPoint template skills from user-supplied files.
- Core workflows integrate Excel and Office JS/Python environments for flexible model-building.
- Includes detailed instructions and best practices for financial modeling and analysis.
